## Description

**What**: Update project reference documentation to reflect the cross-runner equivalence contract testing infrastructure.
**Why**: A new pre-commit hook (runner-touch-check.sh), a new validate.sh --ci gate (test-runner-equivalence.sh), and a new manifest (plugins/dso/config/test-runners.yaml) are shipped by this epic. Per doc-router Gate 2 (extends an existing reference doc), these belong in the existing reference docs.
**Scope**:
- IN: Add the runner-touch-check.sh pre-commit hook entry to HOOKS-REFERENCE.md; document the equivalence-test gate + manifest in CI-INTEGRATION.md (and/or the validate.sh section); reference docs/runners/classification-semantics.md and the test-runners.yaml manifest from the appropriate reference doc.
- OUT: docs/runners/classification-semantics.md and the tests/runners/fixtures/ README (authored within the implementation stories, not here); CLAUDE.md edits (route any every-session rule through a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report, do not edit CLAUDE.md directly).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, HOOKS-REFERENCE.md documents the runner-touch-check.sh pre-commit hook (its hard-block behavior, manifest-derived path filter, and fail-loud-on-missing-path semantics)
  ← Validates Closure Check: "New pre-commit hooks and CI gates are documented in the project reference docs"
- When this story is complete, the equivalence-test gate and the test-runners.yaml manifest are documented in the CI-integration / validate.sh reference doc so future harness contributors find the contract
  ← Validates Closure Check: "New pre-commit hooks and CI gates are documented in the project reference docs"

## Considerations

- [Doc-router] Apply doc-router.md gates before writing. CLAUDE.md edits require a CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report — do not edit CLAUDE.md directly. If .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md exists, follow it for formatting.
- [Scope] Update existing docs only; do not create new documentation files.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: Update project docs to reflect cross-runner equivalence contract testing
